blocks.orig: Fun Beach Resort on Zanzibar’s southeast coast combines beachfront living with plenty of space to swim, eat, and relax. The resort has rooms, bungalows, and suites, each fitted with air conditioning, Wi-Fi, hot water showers, private bathrooms, mosquito nets, and safes. Between ocean swims or dips in the two pools here, you can enjoy spa treatments, relax in the lounge under a makuti roof (dried coconut palm leaves), or dine on local seafood and international cuisine with vegetarian and vegan options available. And drinks flow from the bar throughout the day, while the beach (lined with coconut trees) offers space for relaxation and fun.
blocks.html: On the southeast coast of Zanzibar, Fun Beach Resort offers life on the beach with lots of room to swim, eat and unwind. You can choose from rooms, bungalows and suites, all with air conditioning, Wi-Fi, hot showers, private bathrooms, mosquito nets and safes. In between swims in the ocean or in one of the two pools, you can book spa treatments, relax in the lounge beneath a makuti roof (made of dried coconut palm leaves), or have a meal of local seafood and international dishes, with vegetarian and vegan choices. The bar serves drinks all day long, and the beach, lined with coconut trees, gives you room for relaxing and having fun.
